# K2SO held public-flag transition fixture

This disposable F210 fixture prepares a state-only native regression for the post-1165 Imersite carrier handoff. The source stage runs the accepted E3A MIR 5.0.21000 input and seeds a detached active private `mir-k2-imersite-staged-state-1` level 4 credit with `0.27` saved work. Its `change-recipe-productivity` value is the published/current K2SO scalar `0.02`, so the source witness expects `0.06` native powder productivity. This is a fixture seed, not a laboratory-earned or historical-save claim.

The source also creates a separate foreign force whose unqueued public early and continuation rows are both disabled but have deliberately opposite `visible_when_disabled` values. It makes no MIR private API or storage calls. The fixed fixture version is prepared for Factorio's ordinary `on_configuration_changed`; before writing fixture state it requires the post-handoff public level/progress/bonus and player/foreign flags. No public technology is queued in this case because disabled queued public state remains an unqualified native engine condition.

Both legs use `CaseName=k2-imersite-held-public-flags`, defer `INITIAL` and `game.server_save` until the first real server tick after `--create` or the fixed configuration callback, and reserve two read-only cold reloads. The focused host double supplies expected post-MIR state only to exercise this fixture's prewrite checks: it neither invokes nor evidences the real MIR configuration callback or its ordering. The fixture has zero laboratory completions; source-save hashes and native execution remain pending.

The [prepared-input receipt](../../../spec/evidence/k2-imersite-held-public-flags-inputs-3d1c6d16.json) freezes both tiny containers from immutable raw Git `3d1c6d166ce1a412cab2dc9bdd506d1de7afe00d`. Each projection has exactly seven members: stage `info.json`, `control.lua`, `data-final-fixes.lua`, and `settings-updates.lua` from `source/` or `fixed/`, plus the shared aliases `fixture_control.lua`, `fixture_data_final.lua`, and `fixture_settings.lua`. The source projection/container is `mir-fixture-mir5-k2-imersite-held-public-flags_0.1.0.zip` `9CC52FD88DFFA2081FEB77B539A5C2AF0CE820C4ECD62FE1146F7FBA31837BAA` (6820 bytes); the fixed projection/container is `mir-fixture-mir5-k2-imersite-held-public-flags_0.2.0.zip` `0DA6D8B9FFEADE9DF6B5EE9B160490BAC7663EB3AE0E59CCEADA9A03E01F80C9` (6819 bytes). Both seven-member pairs passed `Assert-MIRLibraryFixtureArchive`; neither container is a native, lab, or source-save result.

The source profile pins the accepted b251/E3A input: source `b251ae7a54104ace87cb0da4cf531cf53f03c93d`, player tree `79b73a6a8e68987737e69bf2d95ec6555b49f901`, and `more-infinite-research_5.0.21000.zip` `E3A65C08AC7798A66FB1BE30D24307B17C8B366DD901953BDE2A09BD6939C8CE` (679250 bytes). The fixed profile pins source `6786c95704fdd6b7a8fcee645c375f54ac8d03da`, player tree `b6857d3774ffd792f82f5bb3ee38b312abedc7b4`, and the 679575-byte F210 archive `59C14208B200CC534353CD46391210FE0B53E4C5739FFE8A3633B5D82DEE8C47`. It remains prepared rather than a native result until an immutable source save and native execution are recorded.

The source-stage scalar is not inherited from the older configured 4.6 five-level/10% case. At the pinned E3A source, `source/research/k2_imersite.lua` fixes the powder effect at `0.02`; the independently authored stream declaration in `source/research/historical_settings.lua` uses `effect_percent = 2` and gives K2SO this stream's default `max_level = 0`. A level-4, unresearched carrier therefore represents three completed 2% levels and expects 6%. `spec/evidence/k2so-material-native-chain.json` separately records F210 K2SO native 2% per completed level and 6% after three levels for different material rows; it corroborates the engine scalar semantics but is not this E3A source/save result. The installed 2.1.23 `LuaTechnology.saved_progress` API is read/write in `[0, 1)`, so the fixture's 0.27 source and successor checks are legal API use, still pending native validation here.
